location_fine: corrugated village rooftop above a courtyard
character_types: village man in white cap and khaki jacket
visual_synopsis: Establishing shots of storks nesting on village poles give way to two men sitting on the sloped corrugated roof of a house, arguing and gesturing wildly at each other over some kind of dare, one of them eventually sprawling flat on the roof slope laughing. They then peer down past the chimney at an old woman with a cane crossing the courtyard below, and after whatever they do she is seen face-down on the pavement with her stick lying beside her while the pair react on the roof.
